topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: My marks, my patterns, my skin of ink—now altered, layered with another's claim. Each stroke I once knew has a new shadow, a boldness not mine. The canvas that was wholly mine now whispers of an interloper's touch. It stands differently, this work that was my silent voice, now it speaks in a dialect I did not teach it. What once was a solitary conversation between me and the world is now a dialogue I never chose to join. The familiar lines of my creation are twisted, the spaces between them filled with unfamiliar stories.
